planned_by: Claude (Critic): external review #2 numbers on screen
goal:
T74 — Arena scoreboard (external review: "no proof numbers on screen; run matches and fill the numbers").
1. API GET /v1/arena/summary (declare it BEFORE /v1/arena/{arena_id} so it is not taken as an id): aggregates EVERY
   stored Arena document (use postgres_state.scan over the arena records — one query, not the 20-newest list), sealed
   and prompt mode alike:
   {"total", "running" (queued/running), "failed", "scored", "unscorable", "inconclusive",
    "wins": {"evoforge", "single", "tie"},
    "heldout": {"single": {"passed", "n"}, "evoforge": {"passed", "n"}},
    "cost_cents": {"single", "evoforge", "judge"}, "basis": "<one sentence>"}.
   "scored" = succeeded arenas whose verdict winner is evoforge, single or tie; held-out totals and costs are summed
   over scored arenas only (unscorable / inconclusive are counted apart and never as a result); judge = the prompt
   judge's judge_cost_cents. Money is integer cents; zeros (not missing keys) when there is nothing.
2. Web: lib/api.ts getArenaSummary() (GET /v1/arena/summary through the proxy; the proxy already allows it); the Arena
   page (app/[locale]/arena/page.tsx) shows a compact scoreboard card at the top: EvoForge wins / single wins / ties,
   held-out pass totals per side, model cost per side and judge cost, plus unscorable/inconclusive counts and the
   basis sentence; fits 375px (wrap, no fixed widths); en + ko messages under "arena" (summary-heading, ...). Plain
   words only (no internal codes).
